notes.title: Spooktacular Special!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 3.0.0 is now live:[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29733493/cdd3c2abf0478a2af55b572a7de4e1af00ecc7e8.jpg[/img]

The Spooktacular Special is here!

Swimdog Co's stock is crashing. As an emergency measure we set up a series of bot net servers out in the field to buy loads and loads of stock, thereby raising our stock price. But competing organizations have caught on to our tricks and are trying to control our bot nets for their own gain. As the new hiree, you need to get your ass out there and recover as many servers as possible. CAPICHE?
[list]
[*]Added new game mode: Concmination. Compete against other teams by capturing bot net beacons before the timer runs out.
[*]Added debut Concmination map: Big Barry's Barnyard Brawl. After Big Barry declared bankruptcy, Swimdog Co. seized all liquidized assets.
[*]Added 13 new playerskins.
[*]Added a new achievement.
[*]Added ability to see another player's Concs.
[*]Updated Conc particle effect.
[*]Fixed players getting stuck on barrels in Boris's Banging Butte.
[*]Fixed players falling through the starting area in Gerald's Grand Gallery.
[*]Fixed misaligned lasers on Optical Course custom jump.
[/list]

notes.title: 2.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 2.0.2 is now live:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Added achievements. We plan on adding more as we update the game.
[*]Optimized the predefined levels. They should look less buggy, run faster, and load quicker.
[*]Removed the last platform on Disappearing Blocks. It ate up like 15 minutes if you made a mistake. Now it's less time-consuming, but now requires you to double conc very quickly to complete.
[*]Increased portal size on Schrodinger to make teleporting more reliable.
[*]Fixed misaligned textures on Wesley's Wild World.
[*]Fixed various boundary issues.
[/list]

[b]Upcoming content:[/b]

In addition to the 5-course campaign and custom courses, we're also planning to add even more levels free of charge, dubbed the Flavor Pack. Right now we're working hard on an upcoming level along with some other goodies. It should be out within the next couple of weeks or so.

For those wondering about the soundtrack, they are located within the game folders as MP3 files. The OST is also integrated into the Steam's built-in music player.

Thanks for keeping Concs alive, and let us know what you think on the forums.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29733493/6a488e567d954cf344a8522178e3f23bd3dceb92.png[/img]
